corpus: mixed human/model final text from earlier sessions
finding: No useful primary personal advantage is established. Useful base and pooled advantage remains unresolved under both interval methods; useful donor advantage is excluded under writer resampling but unresolved under crossed resampling. Useful uniform advantage is excluded under both, and all primary intervals include zero. Adapted-minus-base donor and pooled useful advantage remains unresolved under both methods, with all model-rival intervals including zero. Residual uniform useful advantage is excluded under both methods, with worse performance only under writer resampling. Raw base and donor useful advantage is excluded under writer resampling but unresolved under crossed resampling; raw pooled useful advantage remains unresolved under both methods. All raw model-rival intervals include zero. Raw sums are worse than uniform under both methods. No parity follows.
limits: Full final documents include accepted model insertions and do not isolate human-only learning. Additional passes repeat existing text; they do not add personal information. Sparse histories, rank transferred from human-text calibration, shared human units, seed-dependent pooled ordering, fixed donor/global training and exposed prompts bound the recipe. No independent human confirmation, epoch or seed ranking, population limit, private-goal inference or whole-matrix verdict. Earlier failed/unknown attempts remain separate; no new retry.
